scenes.text: Free trial liya, phir *wapas nahi aaya?*
scenes.say: Gym owners. Free trial liya, aur member wapas hi nahi aaya?
Teen WhatsApp messages. Teesra sabse zaroori hai.

scenes.title: 1. Trial ke *1 ghante* baad
scenes.name: Your Gym

msgs.text: Hi Rohit 💪 aaj ka workout kaisa laga? Aapke goal (fat loss) ke liye *4-week plan* bhej raha hoon 📎

scenes.say: Trial ke ek ghante baad, unke goal ke hisaab se free plan bhejo.

scenes.title: 2. *Agle din*: trainer ka voice note
scenes.name: Coach Aman

msgs.text: 🎤 0:18 · "Rohit, kal aapka squat form achha tha. Kal 7 baje aao, legs karte hain."

scenes.say: Agle din trainer ka chhota voice note. Naam ke saath. Ye sabse personal lagta hai.

scenes.title: 3. *Day 3*: deadline wala offer
scenes.name: Your Gym

msgs.text: Rohit, trial members ke liye joining fee *maaf* hai, sirf *Sunday tak*. Slot hold karun? ✅

scenes.say: Teesre din, deadline wala offer. Deadline se hi decision hota hai.

scenes.title: Example: *20 trials* a month
scenes.say: Bees trials mein se teen ki jagah chhe se aath join kar sakte hain. Example hai, par farq saaf hai.

scenes.text: Ye 3 messages *khud* bhejo. Ya hum *auto* set kar dein?
scenes.sub: Comment karo AUDIT: aapke gym ka free plan
scenes.say: Ye khud kar sakte ho. Automatic chahiye to comment karo AUDIT.

caption:
Gym owners: free trial ke baad member wapas kyun nahi aata? Kyunki koi follow-up nahi hota. 💪

Business of the Day: Gym
Screenshot lo, aaj se lagao 👇
1️⃣ Trial ke 1 ghante baad: goal ke hisaab se free 4-week plan
2️⃣ Agle din: trainer ka 15-sec voice note, naam ke saath
3️⃣ Day 3: joining fee maaf, sirf Sunday tak (deadline = decision)

Example: 20 trials/month, 3 ki jagah 6-8 join. Same trials, zyaada members.

Khud bhej sakte ho. Automatic chahiye? Comment "AUDIT" 👇
